5 result(s) across 21st.dev (metadata only).

### [component] Heat Calendar  [id: 29361]
by starc007
A GitHub-style activity calendar that visualizes weekly intensity values as a single-hue grid, with a legend, hover/click tooltips, and range selection with totals.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_3GMbzDOOqkmdobxoz8ep4iCuufg/heat-calendar/default/preview.1790093196255.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/starc007/heat-calendar?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 29361 })

### [component] Habit Tracker Calendar  [id: 25158]
by cnippet-dev
A monthly calendar that highlights completed days with check indicators and shows a running count of days completed this month for habit tracking.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/cnippet.dev/v-calendar-16/default/preview.1787188041020-e8e27537-7501-41a3-90bf-105ec10a8acb.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/cnippet-dev/v-calendar-16?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 25158 })

### [component] Meeting Booking Calendar  [id: 38035]
by kedhareswer
Meeting booking calendar: a book-a-call section that does the booking itself. A bold headline over a scheduler window with the host's card, call lengths and a timezone-aware week of open slots. Pick a slot and it grows into a confirm form; confirm and it flips into a perforated ticket stamped booked, with an .ics download. A Check against my calendar switch hatches your busy blocks and strikes clashing slots. Fully customisable host, hours, slots and colours.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/kedhareswer/open-slot-booking/default/preview.1791954021018-34f09e50-c1ef-430e-ac08-3a79cf3d91a7.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/kedhareswer/open-slot-booking?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 38035 })

### [component] Activity Heatmap  [id: 35054]
by kuratlielia
A GitHub-style contribution calendar that shows a year of daily activity as one tinted square per day, with hover/keyboard tooltips and a level legend.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_registry_kuratlielia_1790903117010/activity-heatmap/default/preview.1790977701025.webp
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/kuratlielia/activity-heatmap?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 35054 })

by originui
Calendar [React-Area]
